title: US Labor Market Tracker – Balanced and broadening
author: Keith Mason
text:
RESEARCH BRIEFING

16 Sep 2026

US Labor Market Tracker – Balanced and broadening

Discover the latest trends in the labour market, highlighting job growth
diversification and the impact of AI on various sectors. Read more for insights.

The latest Labor Market Tracker indicates a balanced labor market, with job conditions remaining stable in August, similar to July. A positive trend is noted in the broadening of job gains, reducing reliance on the healthcare sector.

While hiring and layoffs have remained low, the recent payroll data suggests
that the apparent strength in job growth may be overstated due to seasonal
factors. The three-month moving average of job growth stands at 71,000, aligning
closely with the estimated break-even pace of 50,000 for this year.

Encouragingly, job growth has diversified beyond healthcare, with sectors like
transportation and professional services showing increased momentum. However,
information and financial activities continue to experience job losses, largely
attributed to the adoption of AI technologies.
